messages:
maria: Heads-up: Scheduled maintenance + controlled regional failover this Sat 2024-08-17 02:00-04:00 UTC for us-west-1. We'll apply kernel microcode + router firmware. Expect short p95 spikes; no planned full outage. Playbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/region-maint

jon: ETA on router rewrite? Any client-facing page impacts?

maria: No full outage expected. Plan: staggered AZ drains (10m rolling), KV cache warmup. Expected: ~1-3s p95 bump for ~15m during AZ switchover. Temporary SLO tweak: p95 target relaxed 300ms->600ms for the window to avoid noisy alerts. I'll file the SR.

tim: Can we limit noncritical background jobs during the window? Want to avoid extra load from batch workers.

maria: Yes — flip background concurrency in us-west-1. Example command to patch the worker deploy:

```
kubectl -n infra patch deploy bg-workers -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","env":[{"name":"CONCURRENCY","value":"1"}]}}]}}}'
```

ashley: Noted. Who's primary oncall for the window?

maria: @jon primary, @tim backup. Pager rotations remain the same. Oncall runbook: https://go/redwood/oncall/runbooks/az-drain

sre-bot: Deploy webhook: canary applying to 2 nodes in us-west-1 now — build 1234. CI logs: https://ci.redwood/1234

jon: I'll be online for the window. If error rate >5% for >10m, abort and roll back. I've bumped alert thresholds in ops config for the maintenance window.

maria: Rolling traffic cut plan: shift 10% every 2m to canary region, hold 5m stability checks between steps. Preflight load test Thu 20:00 UTC (synthetic at /v1/generate). Please pause large batch jobs then.

tim: 44d Will coordinate with infra to reserve extra capacity and schedule a dry-run earlier today.

ashley: Do we need any customer-facing SLA comms?

maria: No external SLA change; this is an internal SLO relaxation limited to the maintenance window. Filed INC-2024-998 and updated the support note: "Maintenance window may increase response times in us-west-1 Sat 02-04 UTC."

jon: LGTM :thumbsup:
